## Notes

Wube Software (Prague), developed since mid-2012; Indiegogo campaign 2013-01-31 to 2013-03-03; downloadable from the official site early in development; Steam early access 2016-02-25; 1.0 on 2020-08-14; Space Age expansion 2024-10-21; Nintendo Switch 2022-10-28; co-op and competitive multiplayer; Lua mods via mod portal; lead designer Michal Kovarik cited the Minecraft mods IndustrialCraft and BuildCraft; 3.5 million sold by December 2022.
